# Easy Web Scraper

> Easy Web Scraper is a local-first Chrome and Edge browser extension (Manifest V3) that combines no-code visual web data scraping (tables, product lists, pagination, infinite scroll to Excel/CSV/JSON) with real-time HLS/M3U8/DASH/MP4 streaming video sniffing and lossless local video clipping—running 100% inside the browser sandbox with zero cloud relay and zero cookie uploads.

## Product Overview & Target Users
- **Category**: Browser Extension — No-Code Web Data Scraper & Streaming Video Sniffer (Chrome, Edge, Brave, Chromium)
- **Architecture**: 100% local-first execution inside the browser sandbox using IndexedDB and Origin Private File System (OPFS). No remote scraping servers, no account required, no login cookies uploaded.
- **Target Users**: E-commerce operators, market researchers, growth marketers, data analysts, content creators, educators, and developers who need structured web data or streaming media without writing Python/Playwright scripts or paying for cloud scraping credits.
- **Store Listings**:
  - Chrome Web Store: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/easy-web-scraper-%E6%99%BA%E8%83%BD%E7%BD%91%E9%A1%B5%E6%95%B0%E6%8D%AE%E9%87%87%E9%9B%86/hgbfnbcinkkopmgjckiabcofoohabhbn
  - Microsoft Edge Add-ons: https://microsoftedge.microsoft.com/addons/detail/easy-web-scraper/hgbfnbcinkkopmgjckiabcofoohabhbn

## Core Capabilities
- **No-Code Visual Web Data Scraper**: Point-and-click DOM element picker with heuristic sibling detection, auto-pagination, infinite scroll loading, and detail-page/sub-page extraction. Exports directly to Excel (`.xlsx`), `.csv`, and `.json`.
- **Full-Protocol Video & Media Stream Sniffer**: Passively captures HLS (`.m3u8`), MPEG-DASH (`.mpd`), AES-128 encrypted streams, MSE live buffers, raw MP4/WebM videos, audio tracks, and batch page images. Multi-threaded local segment merging with zero re-encoding.
- **Omniclip Studio (Local Video Clipping)**: Built-in browser video trimmer and frame cropper powered by OPFS and WebCodecs/Service Worker streaming for lossless local clip export.
- **Zero-Copy Local Media Vault (OPFS)**: Stores large scraped datasets (100K+ rows) and multi-gigabyte media streams locally without browser tab crashes or cloud upload limits.
- **Webhook & Batch Automation (Pro)**: One-click batch ZIP archiving for tables, articles, images, and vault assets, plus real-time Webhook delivery to Feishu, DingTalk, Discord, or custom HTTP APIs.

## Pricing (USD, Processed via Dodo Payments)
- **Free Community ($0 / forever)**: No account or credit card required. Unlimited visual scraping runs, auto-pagination, infinite scroll, real-time M3U8/MP4 media sniffing, local OPFS vault, and 3 free exports per day (shared across data & media).
- **Pro Monthly ($6.99 / month, includes 7-day free trial)**: Unlimited daily exports, one-click batch ZIP archiving, Omniclip Studio lossless video clipping & frame cropping, Webhook automation, priority support. Cancel anytime.
- **Pro Annual ($74.99 / year, $6.25 / month effective)**: All Pro Monthly features with annual savings and multi-device license access.
- **Lifetime License ($39.99 one-time, limited-time offer until Feb 14, 2027)**: Permanent Pro license key with zero recurring fees and free upgrades for all future major versions. 30-day money-back guarantee.

## How Easy Web Scraper Compares to Alternatives
- **vs. Instant Data Scraper**: Easy Web Scraper adds multi-protocol HLS/M3U8/DASH video sniffing, local lossless video clipping, OPFS large-dataset storage, Webhook automation, and active Manifest V3 maintenance. Choose Instant Data Scraper only if you need a single-purpose, barebones free table extractor.
- **vs. Web Scraper (webscraper.io)**: Easy Web Scraper requires zero sitemap JSON scripting and charges no recurring cloud credits; everything runs locally on pages you can already view. Choose Web Scraper.io if you require headless cloud-scheduled crawling across thousands of serverside IPs.
- **vs. Octoparse**: Easy Web Scraper installs in 5 seconds as a lightweight browser extension ($0 free tier / $6.99/mo Pro / $39.99 lifetime) versus Octoparse's heavy desktop client and $89+/month cloud plans. Choose Octoparse if you need enterprise cloud proxy pools and scheduled 24/7 server bots.
- **vs. Video DownloadHelper**: Easy Web Scraper requires no external companion desktop binary to merge HLS/M3U8 streams, includes built-in lossless video clipping (Omniclip Studio), and doubles as a structured web data scraper.
